subject: Post-discovery: Demo scheduling - FinBank
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@finbank.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery: Demo scheduling - FinBank

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for taking the time today — really useful conversation. Quick recap from our side: 
- Primary use case: low-latency, cost-predictable inference for customer support routing and response generation (short responses, 128-256 token windows).
- Key constraints: SOC 2 evidence, VPC/private deployment for customer PII, predictable per-request latency at 95th pct.
- Success criteria: 95th pct latency < 200ms on dedicated nodes, ability to roll model updates with canary testing.

Next step: we recommend a 30-min demo/introduction where Aditya (our solutions engineer) can do a technical deep-dive and surface deployment/architecture options. Can you confirm prefered time for a 30-min slot? Here are a few options from our side (all PST):

Option A — Tue Mar 3, 10:00–10:30 AM
Option B — Wed Mar 4, 2:00–2:30 PM
Option C — Thu Mar 5, 9:00–9:30 AM

Please let me know which works best and who from your side should join (CTO, Security, Platform?). I’ve attached a short one-pager with the discovery notes.

If none of those work, happy to send a Calendly link.

Talk soon —
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0199

Attachments: Discovery-Notes-FinBank.pdf (PDF, 1 page summary of discovery call)

From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@finbank.com>

Cc: security@finbank.com
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: Demo scheduling - FinBank

Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear recap and for the note. Wed Mar 4 2:00–2:30 PM PST (Option B) works for me. I will invite our CTO (Mark Liu) and Security lead (Anita Desai) to join.

A couple quick asks for the demo agenda:
- 15–20 min technical demo focused on latency, deployment model (VPC/dedicated), and integration points
- 10–15 min Q&A on SOC 2/KMS and data residency

Please send a calendar invite and an agenda doc if you have one.

—Emily
Emily Carter
Head of Platform Engineering, FinBank
emily.carter@finbank.com | (212) 555-0144

Emily — great, thanks for confirming. I’ve put Wed, Mar 4 2:00–2:30 PM PST on the calendar and invited Mark and Anita. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-finbank-demo-03042026

Aditya — looping you in to run the demo. Key asks from the discovery: latency SLO, private deployment options (VPC + KMS/HSM), and rollback/canary rollout pattern. Suggested agenda below — feel free to adjust.

Agenda (30 min)
- 0–5 min: quick introductions and success criteria (Vanessa / Emily)
- 5–20 min: technical demo (Aditya) — serving runtime, routing, and VPC options
- 20–28 min: SOC 2 / security integration overview (Marissa)
- 28–30 min: next steps / decision timeline (Vanessa)

Emily — attaching the discovery notes again and a short agenda doc. If anything changes feel free to reply-all and we’ll update.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
